introduction: The Goblin Sin-bi Show begins with dazzling lights!Sin-bi appears before the Goblins (the audience) and holds the 'Goblin Exorcism Squad Audition' to test the power of their voices.The joyful atmosphere is short-lived, however, as the story-controlling ghost, Theater Ghost, appears and traps Sin-bi and the Goblins inside a theater. Theater Ghost is a ghost who lives hidden in movie theaters because he loves stories!Theater Ghost picks out memories he likes and changes the story at will, putting Sin-bi, Ha-ri, and Kang-rim in danger.To save them, only one thing is needed: the Goblins' loud voices!An 'Energy Ball' created from the cheering sounds of the Goblins choosing paths, solving riddles, and chanting spells instills courage in Shinbi.However, Theater Ghost's fierce final attack puts Shinbi in great danger, and since she lacks the energy to use magic, the Goblins must gather their voices one last time to help her…Our shouts can change the story! Shout out, Goblins! Defeat the Theater Ghost!
